title: WWTPs Raw sequence reads
description: Although there have been some studies on the bacterial community compositions of activated sludge, the knowledge of the bacterial communities in high elevational activated sludge is poor understood. The objectives of this study is to analysis the bacterial community compositions of activated sludge at high elevational WWTPs.
center: Laboratory of Zoological Systematics and Evolution, Institute of Zoology
samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from activated sludge metagenome
